content:
Maya Chen: Quick check — we should lock a 60m postmortem for the Lambda throughput regression yesterday. Proposed Wed 10:30–11:30 PT. Who needs to be in the room?
Samir Patel: I can be there. SRE + infra + owning service (catalog) definitely.
Kevin O'Neill: I'll join for RCA and perf traces. Can someone add the tracker link?
Priya Rao: Product + CS should attend for impact context. Dina, can you join?
Dina Park: Yep, I can. Also suggest inviting a customer-success rep who handled the chat thread.
Alex Gomez: FYI ops team will be busy Wed morning until 11, prefer 11:30 if we can shift 30m later.
Jordan Li: 11:30 PT works for me. If we move, 11:30–12:30 PT ok?
Maya Chen: OK quick poll: A) Wed 10:30–11:30 PT (original) B) Wed 11:30–12:30 PT (shifted). Reply with A or B.
Samir Patel: B
Kevin O'Neill: B
Priya Rao: B (product prefers later too)
Dina Park: B
Alex Gomez: B
Jordan Li: B
Maya Chen: Consensus = B. I'll send invite for Wed 11:30–12:30 PT and include the following agenda. Please add any missing items.
Maya Chen: ```Agenda (60m)
- 11:30–11:40 (10m): Quick impact summary + timeline highlights — Dina (prod)
- 11:40–12:00 (20m): Technical timeline + traces — Kevin (SRE)
- 12:00–12:20 (20m): Root cause hypotheses + mitigation options — Samir (infra)
- 12:20–12:30 (10m): Action triage, owners, deadlines — Priya (action lead)
```
Priya Rao: I'll take action triage and keep action items as a single tracked checklist. Recommend 2-week follow-up review of actions.
Kevin O'Neill: Please upload pre-reads: 1) CDN/ingress error logs, 2) collector perf traces, 3) quick MTR of flaky nodes. Easier to review ahead.
Maya Chen: Good call. Can folks drop pre-reads into the retro folder by Tue EOD? Links in the invite.
Dina Park: I'll add customer impact notes and the chat transcript.
Samir Patel: I'll add perf flamegraphs and a short summary of the mitigation we ran.
Alex Gomez: Ops will attach autoscaler metrics + any rollout events.
Jordan Li: I'll triage on-call notes and pagers to include in the timeline.
inc-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0415. The incident channel will be kept for postmortem edits.
calendar-bot: Calendar invite sent to: Maya, Samir, Kevin, Priya, Alex, Jordan, Dina. Invite includes retro folder + pre-read deadline Tue EOD.
Maya Chen: Two process asks before the meeting: 1) section leads (timeline, RCA, actions) should prepare a 2–3 slide summary each, 2) action triage owner (Priya) will allocate severity (P0/P1) and expected delivery window.
Priya Rao: Confirmed. I'll prepare the action template and share before the meeting.
Kevin O'Neill: If any blocker to attending, please post here ASAP so we can rotate presenters.
Dina Park: No blockers. Thanks — will see you Wed 11:30 PT. :+1:
Maya Chen: Thanks all — I'll finalize the invite and add the follow-up cadence: action checkpoint at 2 weeks and final closure check at 6 weeks.
